notes:
Read-only scout; nothing executed from the clone. Clone setup: --depth 1, --no-recurse-submodules, core.hooksPath=/dev/null, core.symlinks=false. Default branch is 'v8', not main. Every API call and the clone succeeded. API scratch files are in graphify-api/.

What it is: a Python CLI plus an agent skill (/graphify) that turns a folder (code, docs, PDFs, office files, images, video/audio via whisper/yt-dlp, SQL schemas, Postgres introspection) into a NetworkX knowledge graph. It parses code locally with tree-sitter ASTs across about 30 languages and uses LLMs for semantic extraction from docs and papers. Extraction runs either through host-agent subagents (dispatch fragments in the skill) or through API backends: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Azure, Bedrock, Ollama. It clusters with Leiden/Louvain. Outputs are graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, an interactive HTML view, an optional Obsidian vault, a --wiki export (index.md plus one article per community, 'agent-crawlable'), Neo4j/FalkorDB pushes, GraphML/SVG, and an MCP server.

Important for the user's premise ('data map, vectorization'): the README states 'Not a vector index. No embeddings, no vector store' (README.md line 38). It is a graph-traversal approach (query BFS/DFS, path, explain), not vector RAG. Its --wiki export is the part most directly comparable to OAW's LLM wiki.

Agent-integration footprint if installed (risk for OAW):
(a) It writes PreToolUse hooks into .claude/settings.json that intercept every Bash, Grep, Read and Glob call (10s timeout, fail-open; --strict / GRAPHIFY_HOOK_STRICT=1 blocks the first raw read per session).
(b) It injects an always-on rules block into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or GEMINI.md telling the agent to run 'graphify query' before any grep or read, and to propagate that rule into every subagent prompt.
(c) It installs git post-commit, post-checkout and post-rewrite hooks that rebuild the graph.
(d) It installs similar hooks for Codex, Gemini, CodeBuddy and Pi.

No .claude-plugin/ or .codex-plugin/ manifest exists, and there is no committed hooks.json, .mcp.json, install.sh or npx installer. Install is via 'uv tool install graphifyy' / pipx / pip.

Supply-chain notes:
- The PyPI name is 'graphifyy' (double y), so a typo installs a different package named 'graphify'. Pin the exact name and version.
- The generated HTML loads vis-network from unpkg and d3/mermaid from CDNs.
- Query logging is opt-in only (querylog.py); I found no telemetry SDKs.
- The CLI prints upsell links to app.graphify.com.
- No binaries, archives or symlinks are committed.
- Two workflows use pull_request_target (repo-side CI concern only).
- Repo-root AGENTS.md and all skill .md files are prompt text aimed at agents: treat them as untrusted data during review.
